time.note: Station and element dates require lookup. Some records predate 1750, including observations in December 1742.

ghcnh_hourly.access_note: Provider access remains external. The retained December 1742 Cambridge payload was independently inspected; other station/element files remain unverified.
ghcnh_hourly.basis: Dates and extent come from the provider sources cited for this dataset. File and observation checks are separate.
ghcnh_hourly.note: No universal earliest year is inferred from one station. Keep variable-specific intervals, source flags and historical station limitations.

domain.note: NWS public and coastal marine zones, including Guam-served Pacific islands. The April 2026 zone cover is generalized to 0.125° for geographic screening. Historical zone changes, event types and actual report locations require archive lookup.

time.note: The latest dated event in the checked 2026 file is 2026-07-31. Newer months require an updated file check; the archive is published after reporting and review.

ncei_storm_events_hail.access_note: Provider web search or annual compressed CSV tables. This inventory links to metadata and access routes; no event data are embedded.
ncei_storm_events_hail.basis: Dates and extent come from the provider sources cited for this dataset. File and observation checks are separate.
ncei_storm_events_hail.note: Hail sizes and reporting completeness vary; a reported maximum is not an area-wide hail footprint. No report does not establish no event.

ncei_storm_events_tornado.note: Reported path segments and EF ratings are not spatially uniform wind observations. No report does not establish no event.

ncei_storm_events_thunderstorm_wind.basis: Dates and extent come from the provider sources cited for this dataset. File and observation checks are separate.

domain.note: Conservative whole-degree boxes enclosing grid coordinates read from NOAA MRMS GRIB2 headers. Field availability differs by domain; the built-in request currently prepares CONUS files only.

uncertain_windows.reason: NOAA documents operational MRMS deployment in 2014. An exact start for this field is not established; earlier research/NMQ products and archives need separate verification.

time.note: NOAA documents the operational transition in 2014, without establishing a universal field start. The built-in AWS archive begins 2020-10-14. Earlier dates require a separately verified archive and field. No current archive endpoint has been verified; open-ended metadata do not establish availability through the requested end date.

mrms_mesh.access_note: NCEP HTTP GRIB2 for operational files; NOAA-managed noaa-mrms-pds cloud archive for selected historical files. Select exact field and dates.
mrms_mesh.basis: Dates and extent come from the provider sources cited for this dataset. File and observation checks are separate.
mrms_mesh.note: MESH is radar-derived hail-size estimation, not observed hail truth; MESHMax windows are separate products.

domain.note: Confirm the named lake in the provider selector. A project point alone does not identify a monitored lake.

time.note: Collection-level dates only. The named lake must have a valid overpass in the project period.

c3s_lake_water_level.access_note: Choose a monitored lake. CDS supplies the lake record; select the project dates after retrieval.
c3s_lake_water_level.basis: Provider catalog and public CDS request constraints.
c3s_lake_water_level.note: Compare vertical references before combining lake heights with gauges. Check per-observation uncertainty and gaps.

domain.note: Coarse boxes enclose the November 2026 daily WTEQ station directory by state. Verify the actual station, elevation and distance in the NRCS directory.

time.note: Operating periods and available daily WTEQ values vary by station. Request the selected dates and inspect gaps.

nrcs_snotel_daily_swe.access_note: Public NRCS Report Generator and AWDB REST API. Supply a station triplet and dates.
nrcs_snotel_daily_swe.basis: Coarse regions enclose coordinates in the cited provider directory, including inactive stations. The cited WTEQ sample verifies three daily values at one site.
nrcs_snotel_daily_swe.note: Choose a SNOTEL station whose location and elevation represent the project. Verify its daily observations and flags at NRCS.

domain.note: GLEAM models land surfaces. Check the actual cell mask and land coverage before averaging.

time.note: Fixed extent documented for the v4.2a deposit.

gleam_v4_2a_actual_evaporation.access_note: Versioned public Zenodo archive. Reuse terms differ between the deposit and the GLEAM policy.
gleam_v4_2a_actual_evaporation.basis: Provider release documentation and a bounded inspection of the daily and annual 1980 files.
gleam_v4_2a_actual_evaporation.note: Grid-cell estimates of actual evapotranspiration. The project footprint does not produce a HUC12 average in this inventory.

storm_reporting_zones.basis: NWS public forecast and coastal marine zones (including the Great Lakes). Conservative intersecting-cell cover; each included cell is at most 0.125 degrees from a source zone in each axis. A current geographic screening proxy for historical reports, not historical zone boundaries or confirmed events.
